enchantments.tooltip: Legendary Magma Surge Guard: This item stores the immeasurable heat of the planet's molten mantle. When the wearer of this item is successfully attacked in melee, superheated magma occasionally surges to the surface, causing a tremendous amount of Fire damage to the attacker.
Strength +14: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +14 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Fire Resistance +53: Passive: +53 Enhancement bonus to your Fire Resistance.
Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.

Devotion of the Firemouth: 3 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Positive, Negative and Repair Amplification+30 Artifact bonus to PRR+15% Artifact bonus to Armor Class+100% Artifact bonus to Threat Generation
Mythic Cloak Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
